title: mapObject, going Object to Object, is the shape that fits
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: This is one level of aggregation — a single total per region. It compiles and runs, but it throws away the category breakdown the report actually needs; West's Widgets and Gadgets are already merged into 140 before there is any chance to split them back out.
